propositions: fetcher._iter_pages terminates on short pages and advances by requested page size instead of actual page length, causing issues to be silently lost from the inbound snapshot when Jira Data Center caps page results below the requested size
92% of issues (230 of 250) are lost when a server caps pages at 20 but page_size is 100, because the first truncated page is read as the final page
the pager does not detect or guard against servers that ignore startAt and return the same non-empty page indefinitely, causing infinite loops
termination must be on empty pages only with advance by len(page) to match the fix already applied to get_parent_map and handle server-side truncation correctly
existing behaviors for cap clipping, ACLI ceiling raise, and same-token-twice stall guards must remain unchanged to preserve the Cloud contract
